title: Order cancellation
objective: Let customers cancel an order while it is still ACTIVE, and tell the warehouse through the existing event queue, so support staff stop editing order rows by hand.
current_behavior: Orders change state only through `OrderService` (`src/orders/service.ts`). There is no cancellation path; `OrderService.refund` is the closest precedent and publishes `order.refunded`.

in_scope.text: Customer-initiated cancellation of an ACTIVE order.
A cancel button on the order page.

out_of_scope.reason: Q1 is open; the research recommends rejecting it.
The payment service owns refunds and the request does not ask for it.

criteria.statement: A customer can cancel their own order while it is ACTIVE.
Cancelling an order the caller does not own is rejected.
A cancellation publishes an event the warehouse can read.
The order page offers cancellation for an ACTIVE order.

deliverables.title: Cancellation endpoint
deliverables.outcome: A customer can cancel an ACTIVE order through the API and the warehouse receives `order.cancelled`.

deliverables.title: Cancel button
deliverables.outcome: A customer can cancel an ACTIVE order from the order page.

requirements.title: Cancel an active order
requirements.statement: WHEN the owner of an ACTIVE order requests its cancellation THE SYSTEM SHALL set the order status to CANCELLED.

acceptance.given: order `o-1` owned by user `u-1` with status ACTIVE
acceptance.then: the response status is 200 and `o-1` has status CANCELLED

requirements.title: Reject another user's order
requirements.statement: IF the caller does not own the order THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL reject the cancellation with status 403.

acceptance.given: order `o-1` owned by user `u-1` with status ACTIVE
acceptance.then: the response status is 403 and `o-1` remains ACTIVE

requirements.title: Publish the cancellation
requirements.statement: WHEN an order is cancelled THE SYSTEM SHALL publish `order.cancelled` carrying the order identifier.

acceptance.then: one `order.cancelled` message with `orderId` `o-1` and message group `o-1` is on the queue

requirements.title: Offer the cancel button
requirements.statement: WHILE an order is ACTIVE THE SYSTEM SHALL show a Cancel order button on the order page.

acceptance.given: the order page for ACTIVE order `o-1`
acceptance.then: a Cancel order button is visible

acceptance.given: the order page for SHIPPED order `o-2`
acceptance.then: no Cancel order button is shown

contracts_provided.name: Cancel order endpoint
contracts_provided.shape: `POST /orders/:id/cancel`, no body. 200 with the order JSON; 403 when the caller does not own it; 409 when it is not ACTIVE.

evidence.fact: `MessageGroupId` is required for every message sent to a FIFO queue.
evidence.rule: Set the order id as the message group of `order.cancelled`.

assumptions.text: CANCELLED is a new terminal status that no existing flow reads.

open_questions.question: May a customer cancel an order after it has shipped?

options.label: No, only before shipping
options.description: Matches the refund flow, which rejects orders in the wrong state.

options.label: Yes, as a return request
options.description: Needs a new RETURN_REQUESTED state and a warehouse notification.
